description: This file contains server-side code for the 'Leaderboard' web page in an online examination system, handling page load, session management, and navigation button events.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard ASP.NET page handling page load and navigation button events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page, verifies user session, fetches user semester info from database, and manages session data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Empty event handler for the leaderboard button click.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Clears user session and redirects to login page upon logout.
